name: popscale-platform
description: Read public Popscale documentation and safely administer company-scoped interviews, learning content, journeys, and usage insights through separate remote MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Manage content and analyze company learning
interface.longDescription: Search the public, read-only Popscale Docs MCP or connect to the company-scoped Popscale Platform MCP to find, create, and granularly edit learning content; administer interview Studies; build validated journeys; or compare privacy-safe Journey participation and content outcomes with bounded member drilldown. Customer data stays inside the OAuth-selected company, while active edits, generation, distribution, and publication retain dedicated scopes and confirmation boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Search the public Popscale docs for how journeys work and cite the page status.
Compare department outcomes for our pricing roleplay and explain any historical score limitations.
Show my interview Studies and help me edit one question safely.
